title: PackDraft
description: A custom ontology draft. The single shape an org admin, the console, or an agent uses to describe a schema pack before it becomes a gbrain manifest. Draft a PackDraft, then hand it to a human to import and apply; this draft never mutates anything by itself.

name.description: The pack's unique id. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, must start with a letter or digit, at most 64 characters. Cannot match a bundled gbrain pack name, a name starting with mobrain-, or a layer name (my-brain, my-personal).

description.description: One or two sentences, in plain language, describing what ontology this pack adds and who it is for. Shown to admins reviewing the import.

extends.description: The Mo-brain pack this one builds on: mobrain-core, mobrain-personal, or another custom pack whose chain ends at mobrain-core. Required and never null. Its page types, link types and other inheritable fields are merged in by gbrain, but mobrain-core's entries are locked: this draft cannot redeclare a core type, verb or inverse. A pack cannot extend itself. Link verbs may reference parent types that this draft does not declare.

pageTypes.description: The new page types this pack adds on top of its parent. Names used by mobrain-core are refused. Each type owns one folder and may own extra prefixes, but no two types may claim the same folder or prefix.

name.description: The type's id. Lowercase, must start with a letter, then letters, digits, hyphen or underscore, at most 64 characters. Must be unique within pageTypes.

primitive.description: Which gbrain primitive this type is: entity (people, orgs, things), media (files, images, recordings), temporal (events, matters, time-bound records), annotation (notes, inbox items, comments), or concept (ideas, topics, themes).

folder.description: The repo-relative directory that holds this type, like "contracts/" or "legal/contracts/". Must be lowercase, one or more segments each ending in a slash, with no leading slash, no dots and no "..". This becomes the type's first path prefix and its main filing location.

description.description: One sentence describing what a page of this type is, in plain language. Becomes the filing rule's description and guides agents filing pages.

extraPrefixes.description: Additional folder paths that also belong to this type, beyond `folder`. Same format and rules as folder. Use for legacy or alternate locations; leave empty when there are none.

aliases.description: Alternate names that also refer to this type, matched literally by gbrain during type inference. Leave empty when there are none.

extractable.description: True if gbrain should extract facts from pages of this type during sync. Set false for containers or administrative types where extraction adds noise.

expertRouting.description: True if pages of this type should be routed to a domain expert agent. Set false unless the type genuinely benefits from that routing.

linkVerbs.description: The typed relationships pages can form, each as an active verb. A verb may name the from and to page types it connects; they may be provided by the parent. Names used by mobrain-core (verbs and inverses) are refused. Leave the array empty to declare no links.

name.description: The relationship's active verb, in snake_case, like "governs" or "signed". Lowercase, must start with a letter, then letters, digits or underscore, at most 64 characters. Must be unique within linkVerbs.

inverse.description: Optional passive counterpart of the verb, like "governed_by". Same snake_case rules. Omit when the relationship has no natural inverse.

fromType.description: Optional page type that is the source of the relationship, by its `name` in pageTypes (or a parent type when extends is set). It becomes inference.page_type, which lets gbrain infer the link from context.

toType.description: Optional page type that is the target of the relationship, by its `name` in pageTypes (or a parent type when extends is set). It becomes inference.target_type, which lets gbrain infer the link from context.
